sources.name: GWAS Catalog
sources.access: REST API v2 (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/rest/api/v2) for studies-by-PubMed-ID and curated associations; v2 web service (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/api/v2) for study metadata. The legacy REST API (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/rest/api) and the old bulk summary-statistics API both return HTTP 410 and are not called (ToolUniverse #642). Association rows in this build are curated in data/genetics/associations.csv; GCST90454540 has no curated associations in REST API v2 (checked 2026-10-15), so the A0001/A0002 effect estimates cannot be re-verified from the Catalog API and should be checked against PMID:40399555 or the GCST90454540 summary statistics

sources.name: Europe PMC REST API
records_used: PACVS literature sweep queries logged in data/genetics/phenotypes.csv
